messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: Philosophical question about tourr
parts:
Hi,

I have spent some time being impressed/hypnotized by the tourr demo.

Looking at the code, I see it uses reactive calls in conjunction with shiny.

The demo works well self-contained on my laptop.

Would it / could it work well as a web-deployed shiny app? Or would it / could it get bogged down (esp. with many points) in server/client communications, updating for each frame?

This is not a feature request or suggestion - you guys are busy enough. It's just me trying to sort out how all this stuff might be able to work together for the foreseeable future.

Thanks!

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Philosophical question about tourr
parts:
It may get bogged down, but we still have a lot of optimisation to do.
ggvis is always going to be faster when used locally, but I think most
common that don't involve sending heaps of data around should be fine
remotely as well.

Hadley
